name: After recital 13
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the welfare of dogs and cats and their traceability
part_text: (13 a) Former farm animals kept in sanctuaries, as well as cats and dogs bred for scientific purposes that have been rehomed as companion animals, require dedicated caretakers, specialised knowledge, and ongoing advocacy to ensure their well-being. The Comission should assess and propose appropriate legal measures to ensure the recognition, protection and welfare of such animals.
